attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Changing the default DB transaction isolation level from ReadUncommitted to ReadCommitted for all SQL/Sqlite/MySql/Postgres providers can alter concurrency behavior, cause increased blocking/deadlocks, or expose subtly different read semantics across existing multi-tenant sites without any explicit opt-in."}

reason: Changing the default DB transaction isolation level from ReadUncommitted to ReadCommitted for all SQL/Sqlite/MySql/Postgres providers can alter concurrency behavior, cause increased blocking/deadlocks, or expose subtly different read semantics across existing multi-tenant sites without any explicit opt-in.
